title: The Long White Cloud
subtitle: A trip through Aotearoa New Zealand, told in our own photographs
credit: Photographs and voices by Mark and Jen, March–April 2023. Every film was rendered on the Sogni Supernet with MiniMax H3 (FastH3 first-and-last-frame, two-stage 2K), objects traced with Segment Anything 3, and narration spoken in cloned voices with Qwen3-TTS. Built by coding agents with a human approving every take.

places.title: The Round Door
places.caption: Kia ora — hello, goodbye and thank you, all in two words.

lines.text: Kia ora!
lines.speaker: Mark

lines.text: So this is Hobbiton, near Matamata, right near the end of our road trip.
lines.speaker: Mark

lines.text: Everything here is hobbit-sized, so mind your head.
lines.speaker: Mark

hotspots.label: Duck through the round door
hotspots.hint: It opens a long way from a hallway

places.title: The Challenge
places.caption: Stand still. This is how a welcome begins.

lines.text: This is Te Pā Tū, a Māori village in the forest outside Rotorua.
lines.speaker: Mark

lines.text: Before anyone is welcomed in, a warrior comes out with a challenge, and you have to answer it.
lines.speaker: Mark

hotspots.label: Accept the challenge
hotspots.hint: A warrior lays down a token for you

hotspots.label: Follow the rain
hotspots.hint: Every drop here ends up in a waterfall somewhere

places.title: The Haka
places.caption: You feel this one in your chest.

lines.text: Then the haka.
lines.speaker: Mark

lines.text: The Māori had no written language, so song, dance and music carried their history.
lines.speaker: Mark

lines.text: Honestly, the faces and the posturing were the highlight for me.
lines.speaker: Mark

hotspots.label: Stay for the song
hotspots.hint: After the haka, harmony

places.title: The Song
places.caption: Everybody ends up singing.

lines.text: After the haka there’s a guitar, and everybody sings, with sticks keeping time.
lines.speaker: Mark

lines.text: Dinner is a hāngī, cooked for hours in an earth oven.
lines.speaker: Mark

lines.text: It was surprisingly musical, and really interactive.
lines.speaker: Mark

hotspots.label: Into the sound hole
hotspots.hint: Next stop: Milford Sound

places.title: Milford Sound
places.caption: A birthday on the water, and it is raining. Perfect.

lines.text: We spent a night on Milford Sound, on the Fiordland Jewel, for my wife’s birthday.
lines.speaker: Mark

lines.text: It rained, of course.
lines.speaker: Mark

lines.text: And the drive down from Queenstown is worth it all by itself.
lines.speaker: Mark

hotspots.label: Go and stand with him
hotspots.hint: The best view is shared

places.title: Together at the Rail
places.caption: The cliffs do not care, and that is the point.

lines.text: Same view, better company.
lines.speaker: Mark

lines.text: Milford is one of the wettest places on Earth, which is exactly why every cliff is pouring.
lines.speaker: Mark

lines.text: Best birthday ever!
lines.speaker: Jen

hotspots.label: Sail along the cliff
hotspots.hint: Waterfalls ahead

hotspots.label: Watch the ship from the sky

places.title: Three Waterfalls
places.caption: Look up. Keep looking up.

lines.text: After heavy rain, hundreds of waterfalls show up on these cliffs.
lines.speaker: Mark

lines.text: They’re gone again soon after it stops, so look up while you can.
lines.speaker: Mark

hotspots.label: Fly through the spray
hotspots.hint: The biggest fall is around the corner

places.title: Stirling Falls
places.caption: Scale is the whole joke here.

lines.text: That’s Stirling Falls, about 150 metres tall.
lines.speaker: Mark

lines.text: And that tiny white boat at the bottom? That’s a full-size ferry.
lines.speaker: Mark

hotspots.label: Follow the falls up

hotspots.label: Catch the little boat

places.title: The Cloud Wall
places.caption: There is blue sky somewhere above all that.

lines.text: They call it a sound, but Milford is really a fiord, carved out by glaciers.
lines.speaker: Mark

lines.text: There’s blue sky somewhere above all that.

places.title: The Hot Pool
places.caption: Nobody is in a hurry to get out.

lines.text: A hot tub, a wall of glass, and the lake going grey in the mist.
lines.speaker: Mark

lines.text: This is Queenstown, where our road trip north started.
lines.speaker: Mark

places.title: The Road to Aoraki
places.caption: Somewhere in that cloud is a glacier with our name on it.

lines.text: The drive from Queenstown to Aoraki Mount Cook is dramatic.
lines.speaker: Mark

lines.text: The whole valley gets swallowed up by mountains and cloud, and the Tasman Glacier is hiding right in the middle of it.
lines.speaker: Mark

lines.text: I made him pull over for this one.
lines.speaker: Jen

hotspots.label: Look through her lens
hotspots.hint: She is framing the tallest mountain in the country

hotspots.label: Drive on to the heli base

hotspots.label: Check the mirror
hotspots.hint: Keep an eye on the car around here

places.title: Aoraki
places.caption: The cloud piercer.

lines.text: That’s Aoraki, Mount Cook, the tallest mountain in Aotearoa, at 3,724 metres.
lines.speaker: Mark

lines.text: Its name is usually translated as cloud piercer.
lines.speaker: Mark

places.title: The Heli Base
places.caption: We made the cut. Hold on to your hat.

lines.text: Heli-hikes up here get called off at the last minute all the time.
lines.speaker: Mark

lines.text: You don’t know until a few hours before whether the weather lets you fly.
lines.speaker: Mark

lines.text: We made the cut.
lines.speaker: Mark

lines.speaker: Jen

hotspots.label: Take off

places.title: On the Ice
places.caption: Walk where the guide walks.

lines.text: It was our first time on a glacier with crampons and hiking poles.
lines.speaker: Mark

lines.text: The Tasman is the longest glacier in New Zealand.
lines.speaker: Mark

hotspots.label: Ask her which way
hotspots.hint: She has been listening to the guide

hotspots.label: Follow her into the ice cave

places.caption: Trust her.

lines.text: It’s this way. Trust me!

lines.text: Trust her.
lines.speaker: Mark

places.title: Blue Ice
places.caption: The blue is the ice itself, packed so hard the air is squeezed out.

lines.text: The glacier has ice caves right on its surface.
lines.speaker: Mark

lines.text: Inside, the ice glows turquoise, and that slit of daylight is the way out.
lines.speaker: Mark

lines.text: Oh my gosh, look at this blue!

places.title: Sheep Country
places.caption: Aotearoa: the land of the long white cloud.

lines.text: Out here it’s rolling green farmland in every direction.
lines.speaker: Mark

lines.text: New Zealand has about five sheep for every person, and I think most of them live right here.
lines.speaker: Mark
